items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: But I mean the real orchestras around here was Papa Celestan... And he mostly carried a seven piece band.

ctx.x: But you say the other bands, they would play some of that. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

But I mean the real orchestras around here was Papa Celestan, Sidney Desvene, the Maple Leaf band, and John Rubenshut band. And the fourth best band around there. And Bob Lyon. You know what I mean? Bob Lyon is a pretty good band, but not in comparison with those fellas. How was Celestan on the trumpet? Was he a good musician? Well he was never no jazz trumpet player. He was a good musician, but he was never no jazz trumpet player. Good musician, but he was never no jazz trumpet player. When you remember the band…
Speaking of the Trish Kelly band again, Alec, did they ever play those dances you were talking about earlier, such as quadrilles and the zonas?
